dataset_name: Zecpath Confidence and Sentiment Signal Definitions

hesitation.description: Detects observable hesitation markers in transcript text.

response_length.description: Measures the number of words in the candidate response.

response_pace.description: Measures speaking pace when duration information is available.

positive_sentiment.description: Detects positive language in the response.

negative_sentiment.description: Detects negative language in the response.

uncertainty.description: Detects language indicating uncertainty or lack of confidence.

contradiction.description: Identifies differences between current and previously provided information.

communication_strength.description: Combines observable communication signals into a normalized indicator.
